players.bio: José Alfonso Alvarado Pérez (born 15 March 2000), also known as Plátano, is a Mexican professional footballer who plays as a forward for Liga MX club Monterrey. Alvarado was born in the town of El Platanito, Guasave Municipality, Sinaloa.

José Andrés Guardado Hernández (Spanish pronunciation: ; born 28 September 1986) is a Mexican professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Liga MX club León. Popularly known as Principito (Spanish for Little Prince), Guardado came through the youth ranks at Atlas, making his professional debut in 2005 before signing with Spain's Deportivo two years later, where he spent five seasons.
Ángel Israel Mena Delgado (born 21 January 1988) is an Ecuadorian professional footballer who plays as a winger for Liga MX club León and the Ecuador national team.
Ismael Díaz de León (born 12 May 1997) is a Panamanian professional footballer who plays as a left winger for Liga MX club León and the Panama national team.

Jhohan Sebastián Romaña Espitia (born 13 September 1998) is a Colombian professional footballer who plays as a defender for Club Olimpia, on loan from Major League Soccer club Austin FC. Club career Born in Apartadó, Romaña began his career with Categoría Primera A club Independiente Medellín.
Jordi Cortizo de la Piedra (born 30 June 1996) is a Mexican professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Liga MX club Monterrey and the Mexico national team.
Julio José González Vela Alvizu (born 23 April 1991) is a Mexican professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Liga MX club UNAM and the Mexico national team.

Rodrigo Eduardo Echeverría Sáez (born 17 April 1995) is a Chilean professional footballer who plays for Argentine Primera División club Huracán, on loan from Everton de Viña del Mar, and the Chile national team. Primarily a central defender, he can also be deployed as a defensive midfielder.
Santiago Colombatto (born 17 January 1997) is an Argentine professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Liga MX club León.

Santiago Londoño González (born 29 February 2008) is a Colombian footballer who currently plays as a forward for Chilean club Everton on loan from Pachuca. Club career Born in Medellín in the Antioquia Department of Colombia, Londoño began his footballing career with local side Pipe Uribe.
Santiago Gabriel Ormeño Zayas (born 4 February 1994) is a professional footballer who plays as a forward for Liga MX club León. Born in Mexico, he represents the Peru national team.
Sebastián Ignacio Vegas Orellana (Latin American Spanish: ; born 4 December 1996) is a Chilean professional footballer who plays as a defender for Liga MX club Monterrey.
